The flaw is that `isRetryable` should be `false`. A missing required argument is a validation error, which means the request is malformed. Retrying the same request will not succeed; the agent must correct the input before retrying. Setting `isRetryable` to `true` misleads the agent into thinking the same request can be retried as-is.
